_notation._comment: A session pattern is a LIST of sessions. Order does not matter - what matters is how many sessions there are and how long each is. This sidesteps the right-to-left ambiguity of the printed tables entirely.
_notation.group: n = the TOTAL hours across all groups. Each group attends n/2 (with two groups), so the PUPIL sees n/2 and the TEACHER works n. The guide states this explicitly: 4 ساعات بنظام الأفواج (أي ساعتان لكل فوج).
_notation.fortnight_whole: n hours, whole class, every SECOND week (Week A / Week B)
_notation.fortnight_group: every second week, in groups. circled(2) = 1h per group ON THE SAME DAY. circled(4) = 2h per group.
_notation.alt_whole_1_2: alternates weekly: 1 hour one week, 2 hours the next, whole class
_notation.alt_whole1_group4: alternates weekly: week A = 1h whole class, week B = 4h in groups (2h per group). The two MUST sit in non-simultaneous slots across weeks A and B.
_notation.pilot_only: weekly group session that applies ONLY to pilot institutes (المعاهد النموذجية). See open question Q1.
_notation.alt_mech_elec: two group sessions alternating between mechanical engineering (الهندسة الآلية) and electrical engineering (الهندسة الكهربائية)
_notation._correction_2026_08_24: This was recorded backwards at first - as if (n) meant n hours FOR EACH group. Majd challenged it. The guide's own parenthetical settles it: (4) = 4 total = 2 per group. The only evidence for the other reading was the sport-stream footnote, and the school has no sport stream, so that table is gone. All hour figures below are now DERIVED from the session lists rather than typed by hand.

_groups.note: All figures assume a class splits into TWO groups. If any subject here uses three, its numbers change. Open question Q23.

_three_measures.card_hours: Hours of CARDS across the two-week cycle. This is what aSc shows and what last year's export counts per class. Use this when filling the Curriculum sheet.
_three_measures.pupil_hours: What one pupil actually sits through in an average week.
_three_measures.teacher_hours: What the teacher actually works in an average week. Differs from pupil_hours wherever a class splits into groups.
_three_measures._why_it_matters: These are three different numbers for the same lesson. Comparing the wrong pair looks like a contradiction when nothing is wrong.

_validation_2026_08_24.method: Derived card_hours compared against last year's real aSc export for the two Maths classes (3رياضبات1 and 4رياضيات1).
_validation_2026_08_24.result: Arabic, French, English, History-Geography, Maths (7h), Philosophy, Islamic Thought, Sport and Computer Science all match EXACTLY. Physics matches at 7 card-hours (1+3+2+1). Natural Sciences matches at 5 card-hours (1+4, the weekly alternation). Only 4th-year Computer Science differs, by one hour.
_validation_2026_08_24.conclusion: The transcription of the circular agrees with what the school actually ran. The two apparent mismatches were unit confusion - a weekly average compared against a two-week card count - not transcription errors.
